headline: 8 Michigan deals, $80.9M raised — led by Michigan Capital Network Venture Fund V, L.P.

top_deals.company: Michigan Capital Network Venture Fund V, L.P.
top_deals.summary: Michigan Capital Network Venture Fund V, L.P., a Grand Rapids-based investment fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $75M sold to 87 investors. (Amended filing.)
Bfkw, LLC, a Grand Rapids-based health care company, filed a $12M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $2.6M sold to 10 investors. (Amended filing.)
Savlamar, Inc., a Hudsonville-based manufacturing company, filed a $6.1M equity offering under Rule 506(c); $2.5M sold to 3 investors.
GOC Sunset Investors LLC, an Okemos-based residential real estate company, filed a $800K equity offering under Rule 506(b); $800K sold to 15 investors.

new_funds.company: Michigan Capital Network Venture Fund V, L.P.
new_funds.summary: Michigan Capital Network Venture Fund V, L.P., a Grand Rapids-based investment fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $75M sold to 87 investors. (Amended filing.)
TRM Equity Fund III LP, a Southfield-based private equity fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $0 sold.

notable_ma.summary: Daniel Gilbert and others reported a 55.44% stake in Rocket Companies, Inc. (RKT) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 2).
Mat Ishbia and others reported a 80.2% stake in UWM Holdings Corporation (UWMC) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 17).

material_agreements.summary: UWM Holdings Corp (UWMC) entered into a material definitive agreement (equity financing).

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $80.9M sold across 5 Form D filings this week, up 50% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Bfkw, LLC (Grand Rapids, Other Health Care) targeting $12M. Good question to ask: are founders in health care & life sciences favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

2 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $75M raised so far — led by Michigan Capital Network Venture Fund V, L.P. (Other Investment Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?

Mat Ishbia and others reported a 80.2% stake in UWM Holdings Corporation (UWMC) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 17). Schedule 13D filers can push for strategic change, so it's worth asking whether shareholders see a sale or restructuring on the table.
